art_direction: 柔浅桃底，眼线向右轻倾，右望的目光倦倦停住。
composition_variation: Arrange the pair on a mild descending line toward the right, implying a resting lean. The left is wider and more covered at its outer end; the right is smaller with a softly bowed heavy lid. Direct both pupils right. Keep both openings at least one-third height, with softly curved matching colored lower edges. Preserve exactly TWO eyes with the SAME iris hue, large black pupils and one slim elongated ivory glint each. Emotion comes only from the eye geometry and gaze. Use matte gouache, organic curved tapered boundaries and a visibly pale colored ground; no eyebrows, mouth, head, sclera or other marks.
visible_subject: two eye graphics only; no eyebrows, mouth or head
style_inspiration: Latest user chat image observed locally: a mildly disdainful asymmetric gaze in opaque hand-painted black and cyan eye shapes. Only a written description was transmitted. No chat attachment was uploaded or used as binary input. Earlier eyes-only constraint retained.
visual_review: passed: inspected compressed contact sheet for readable eye expression, coordinated same-color irises, matte curved brush shapes, comfortable pastel background, no added face features, text or watermark
